component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
' Part A: a focused MarkupGrid whose (empty) content node is populated in place, the way JellyRock's ' BaseGridView loads a library. Part B: a JRButtonGroup replica navigated with Left/Right. sub init() m.other = m.top.findNode("other") m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.case = "A0" m.grid.content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.grid.observeField("itemFocused", "onItemFocused") m.grid.observeField("itemUnfocused", "onItemUnfocused") m.other.setFocus(true) m.step = 0 m.keys = [] m.timer.observeField("fire", "onStep") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub onItemFocused() plog(m.case, "itemFocused", "v=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr() + " count=" + m.grid.content.getChildCount().toStr() + " inChain=" + m.grid.isInFocusChain().toStr()) end sub
sub onItemUnfocused() plog(m.case, "itemUnfocused", "v=" + m.grid.itemUnfocused.toStr()) end sub
sub fill(count as integer) content = m.grid.content base = content.getChildCount() for i = 0 to count - 1 item = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.title = "item " + (base + i).toStr() content.appendChild(item) end for end sub
sub settled() plog(m.case, "settled", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr() + " count=" + m.grid.content.getChildCount().toStr()) end sub
sub freshEmpty() m.other.setFocus(true) m.grid.content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") end sub
sub onStep() m.step = m.step + 1 if m.step = 1 ' A1: BaseGridView.onItemDataLoaded - focus the empty grid, jumpToItem 0, then append. m.case = "A1" plog(m.case, "begin", "") m.grid.setFocus(true) plog(m.case, "focused", "") m.grid.jumpToItem = 0 plog(m.case, "jumped", "") fill(8) plog(m.case, "returned", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) else if m.step = 2 settled() ' A2: same, without the jumpToItem. freshEmpty() m.case = "A2" plog(m.case, "begin", "") m.grid.setFocus(true) fill(8) plog(m.case, "returned", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) else if m.step = 3 settled() ' A3: focus the empty grid now, append in a later handler. freshEmpty() m.case = "A3" plog(m.case, "begin", "") m.grid.setFocus(true) plog(m.case, "returned", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) else if m.step = 4 settled() plog(m.case, "fill", "") fill(8) plog(m.case, "filled", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) else if m.step = 5 settled() ' A4: append while unfocused, then focus. freshEmpty() m.case = "A4" plog(m.case, "begin", "") fill(8) plog(m.case, "filled", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) m.grid.setFocus(true) plog(m.case, "returned", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) else if m.step = 6 settled() ' A5: in-place append to a focused, already populated grid away from item 0. m.case = "A5" plog(m.case, "begin", "") m.grid.jumpToItem = 3 plog(m.case, "jumped", "") fill(4) plog(m.case, "returned", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) else if m.step = 7 settled() ' A6: remove every child of the focused grid's content, then append again (a re-sort/refresh). m.case = "A6" plog(m.case, "begin", "") m.grid.content.removeChildrenIndex(m.grid.content.getChildCount(), 0) plog(m.case, "cleared", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) fill(8) plog(m.case, "returned", "itemFocused=" + m.grid.itemFocused.toStr()) else if m.step = 8 settled() startB1() else if m.step = 9 nextKey() end if if m.step < 8 then m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub buildButtons(grp as object, caseName as string) labels = ["Play All", "Shuffle", "Watched", "Favorite", "Refresh"] while grp.getChildCount() > 0 grp.removeChild(grp.getChild(0)) end while for i = 0 to labels.count() - 1 b = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ProbeIconButton") b.id = "b" + i.toStr() b.caseName = caseName b.text = labels[i] grp.appendChild(b) end for end sub
function stateOf(grp as object) as string s = "grpFocus=" + grp.hasFocus().toStr() + " grpFC=" + idOf(grp.focusedChild) for i = 0 to grp.getChildCount() - 1 b = grp.getChild(i) flag = "-" if b.hasFocus() then flag = "F" border = "-" if b.findNode("border").visible then border = "B" s = s + " " + b.id + "=" + flag + border end for return s end function
function idOf(node as object) as string if node = invalid then return "invalid" return node.id end function
sub logState() plog(m.case, "state", stateOf(m.grp)) end sub
' B1: ItemDetails order - the screen holds focus, the hidden empty group is focused (onScreenShown), then ' setupButtons builds the row and focuses the first button directly (focusButtonGroupChild). sub startB1() m.case = "B1" m.grp = m.top.findNode("grpA") m.top.findNode("screenA").setFocus(true) plog(m.case, "groupFocus", "") m.grp.setFocus(true) buildButtons(m.grp, m.case) m.grp.visible = true m.grp.buttonFocused = 0 plog(m.case, "childFocus", "") m.grp.getChild(0).setFocus(true) logState() m.grp.observeField("moved", "onMoved") m.keys = ["Right", "Right", "Right", "Right", "Left", "Left", "Left", "Left"] m.timer.control = "start" end sub
' B2: the screen re-shown after the row was built - the group is focused again, forwarding to its button. sub startB2() m.case = "B2" m.grp.unobserveField("moved") m.grp = m.top.findNode("grpB") m.top.findNode("screenB").setFocus(true) buildButtons(m.grp, m.case) m.grp.visible = true m.grp.buttonFocused = 0 plog(m.case, "childFocus", "") m.grp.getChild(0).setFocus(true) logState() plog(m.case, "groupFocus", "") m.grp.setFocus(true) logState() m.grp.observeField("moved", "onMoved") m.keys = ["Right", "Right", "Right", "Right", "Left", "Left", "Left", "Left"] m.timer.control = "start" end sub
' B3/B4: sgRouter's outlet. Losing the focus chain (focusedChild invalid) while it last had it, it asks the ' active view to take the focus again, and the view re-focuses its saved node: JellyRock's restoreFocus on ' lastFocus = the button group. Both run inside the transaction that took the focus away. sub onOutletFocus(event as object) inChain = event.getData() <> invalid node = event.getRoSGNode() plog(m.case, "outletFC", "id=" + node.id + " inChain=" + inChain.toStr()) if not inChain and m.focusRequestMade <> inChain plog(m.case, "restore", "to=" + m.viewLastFocus.id) m.viewLastFocus.setFocus(true) plog(m.case, "restored", "") end if m.focusRequestMade = inChain end sub
sub startRouted(caseName as string, outletId as string, viewId as string, grpId as string, viaGroup as boolean) m.grp.unobserveField("moved") m.case = caseName m.grp = m.top.findNode(grpId) outlet = m.top.findNode(outletId) m.focusRequestMade = false outlet.observeField("focusedChild", "onOutletFocus") m.top.findNode(viewId).setFocus(true) buildButtons(m.grp, m.case) m.grp.visible = true m.grp.buttonFocused = 0 m.viewLastFocus = m.grp if viaGroup plog(m.case, "groupFocus", "") m.grp.setFocus(true) else plog(m.case, "childFocus", "") m.grp.getChild(0).setFocus(true) end if logState() m.grp.observeField("moved", "onMoved") m.keys = ["Right", "Right", "Right", "Right", "Left", "Left", "Left", "Left"] m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub onMoved() logState() m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub nextKey() m.step = 8 if m.keys.count() = 0 if m.case = "B1" startB2() return else if m.case = "B2" startRouted("B3", "outlet", "view", "grpC", true) return else if m.case = "B3" m.top.findNode("outlet").unobserveField("focusedChild") startRouted("B4", "outlet2", "view2", "grpD", false) return end if plog("done", "", "") m.top.probeExit = true return end if key = m.keys.shift() plog("await", key, "case=" + m.case) end sub
